2400.name: A Cluttered Beach

north.description: To the north lies The Clearing Before The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies In front of a pier at an island.

2400.description:
Open grassland rolls away under a wide sky. The land lies flat and quiet
in every direction. Ways lead north and west.

2401.name: The Clearing Before The Forest

east.description: To the east lies Entrance Into The Caves.

south.description: To the south lies A Cluttered Beach.

west.description: To the west lies A Well Traveled Path.

2401.description:
Old trees crowd close, their roots knotted across the path. Ferns and
moss soften the ground beneath a dim green canopy. Ways lead east, south
and west.

2402.name: A Well Traveled Path

east.description: To the east lies The Clearing Before The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies A Clearing In The Path.

2402.description:
Old trees crowd close, their roots knotted across the path. Birdsong
drifts down through the branches overhead. Ways lead east and west.

2403.name: A Clearing In The Path

north.description: To the north lies The Endless Path Thru The Forest.

east.description: To the east lies A Well Traveled Path.

2403.description:
Old trees crowd close, their roots knotted across the path. Fallen
needles and leaves muffle every step. Ways lead north and east.

2404.name: The Endless Path Thru The Forest

east.description: To the east lies A Small Crowded Clearing.

south.description: To the south lies A Clearing In The Path.

2404.description:
Fallen needles and leaves muffle every step. Old trees crowd close,
their roots knotted across the path. Ways lead east and south.

2405.name: A Small Crowded Clearing

north.description: To the north lies A Rocky Bend In The Trail.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Trail.

west.description: To the west lies The Endless Path Thru The Forest.

2405.description:
Ferns and moss soften the ground beneath a dim green canopy. Fallen
needles and leaves muffle every step. Ways lead north, east and west.

2406.name: A Bend In The Trail

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Crowded Clearing.

2406.description:
Fallen needles and leaves muffle every step. Birdsong drifts down
through the branches overhead. Ways lead north and west.

2407.name: The Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Hills.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Trail.

2407.description:
Shadows gather where the light does not reach. The floor is worn smooth
by long use. Ways lead north and south.

2408.name: A Rocky Bend In The Trail

south.description: To the south lies A Small Crowded Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies A Deep, Dark Cave.

2408.description:
A narrow path winds between the hillocks. The ground rises and falls in
grassy folds. Ways lead south and west.

2409.name: A Deep, Dark Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Rocky Bend In The Trail.

2409.description:
Shadows gather where the light does not reach. The air is still and
smells faintly of old smoke. A way leads east.

2410.name: A Sharp Curve In The Path

north.description: To the north lies Another Bend In The Trail.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Hills.

2410.description:
The ground rises and falls in grassy folds. Rocks break through the thin
soil of the slope. Ways lead north and east.

2411.name: Entrance To The Hills

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Curve In The Path.

2411.description:
The ground rises and falls in grassy folds. Rocks break through the thin
soil of the slope. Ways lead south and west.

2412.name: Another Bend In The Trail

east.description: To the east lies Before The Summit.

south.description: To the south lies A Sharp Curve In The Path.

2412.description:
A narrow ledge picks its way along the mountainside. Wind howls through
a cleft in the stone. Ways lead east and south.

2413.name: Before The Summit

north.description: To the north lies The Final Plateau.

west.description: To the west lies Another Bend In The Trail.

2413.description:
Wind howls through a cleft in the stone. The air is thin and cold, and
loose scree shifts underfoot. Ways lead north and west.

2414.name: Entrance Into The Caves

east.description: To the east lies A Curve In The Caves.

2414.description:
Dust lies thick in the corners, undisturbed for some time. Shadows
gather where the light does not reach. A way leads east.

2415.name: A Curve In The Caves

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance Into The Caves.

2415.description:
The floor is worn smooth by long use. Dust lies thick in the corners,
undisturbed for some time. Ways lead north and west.

2416.name: Another Curve

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Twist.

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend.

2416.description:
The air is still and smells faintly of old smoke. Shadows gather where
the light does not reach. Ways lead north and east.

2417.name: A Sharp Bend

south.description: To the south lies A Curve In The Caves.

west.description: To the west lies Another Curve.

2417.description:
The floor is worn smooth by long use. Stone walls close in, cool to the
touch. Ways lead south and west.

2418.name: A Narrow Twist

east.description: To the east lies The Final Bend.

south.description: To the south lies Another Curve.

2418.description:
The floor is worn smooth by long use. Dust lies thick in the corners,
undisturbed for some time. Ways lead east and south.

2419.name: The Final Bend

north.description: To the north lies The Cave Of Doom.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Twist.

2419.description:
Stone walls close in, cool to the touch. Dust lies thick in the corners,
undisturbed for some time. Ways lead north and west.

2420.name: The Cave Of Doom

south.description: To the south lies The Final Bend.

up.description: To the up lies A Cluttered Beach.

2420.description:
The air is still and smells faintly of old smoke. Dust lies thick in the
corners, undisturbed for some time. Ways lead south and up.

2422.name: The Final Plateau

south.description: To the south lies Before The Summit.

2422.description:
Wind howls through a cleft in the stone. Bare rock climbs steeply on one
side and falls away on the other. A way leads south.
